_readme: The other giraffes. Walk up to one and a prompt appears; press E (or tap TALK)
to hear them, and again for their next line.
Each has `stages`: a set of things to say depending on how many of the glowing
things she's picked up. The stage with the highest `from` that she's reached
is the one they use, so they get steadily more alarmed as she collects more.
`at` is where they stand: [x, y, z]. `outfit` is a list from OUTFITS in
js/giraffe.js: topHat, partyHat, beanie, sunHat, flowerCrown, glasses, shades,
scarf, bowTie, sweater, cape, backpack. `loop` is how wide a circle they
wander in — it gets trimmed automatically if the circle would walk them into
a wall or off a ledge.
Nobody agrees on what the glowing things are called. That's on purpose.
Rewrite any of this. It's all placeholder in the sense that it's mine, not yours.

say: Oh! You must be Sarah. We’ve all been hoping you’d come.
Todd made this whole world for you. Built it with Claude, apparently. I don’t know what that is.
Have a wander. There are some glowy ball things out there if you like that sort of thing.
Perfectly safe, I’m sure. Probably. Nobody’s ever got very many.
You’ve been picking up the glowy ball things, haven’t you.
No no, it’s fine! It’s fine. You just look a bit… lit.
Marlow says there’s an old story about them. Marlow says a lot of things.
Sarah. Sweetheart. You are humming.
I can hear you from the house now. That is new.
Maybe just… stop at that many? For me?
I can’t look directly at you any more.
I told everyone you were lovely. I stand by that. I do.
Please. Not the last one.
Morning! Lovely day. Every day’s lovely here, mind.
You’ll see the shinies about. Little floating ones. Very pretty.
There’s a prophecy about them, supposedly. Sixteen shinies, one giraffe, everything goes a bit wrong.
I wouldn’t worry. Prophecies are mostly weather, in my experience.
So — hypothetically — how many of the shinies have you got?
Mm. Mm-hm. And how do you feel? Powerful? Any urge to rule anything?
No? Good. Good. Great. Fine.
Right, I’ve reread the prophecy. It’s worse than I remembered.
‘And one shall gather the sixteen, and Giraffe World shall kneel.’ That’s the actual line.
It doesn’t say who. It just says one. It could be anyone. It could be you.
I’m packing. I don’t know where I’m going. I’m packing.
Fifteen. FIFTEEN. There is exactly one left, Sarah.
You’re a nice person! Nice people can still end a world! It’s been documented!
I’ve had this hat on for three days in case you turned up. Worth it.
Orbs? Are they orbs? What are they. Nobody will tell me what they’re called.
Bertrand calls them something enormous and I refuse to say it out loud.
You’re glowing! That’s so exciting! Is that a thing you can do?
Wait. Is that from the orbs. Did you take the orbs.
You didn’t take the orbs, did you?? Sarah??
I’ve taken the hat off. It felt inappropriate.
You’re at nine. Nine of them. I counted from here. I could count from here.
Clementine’s crying in the woods. Just so you know that.
I don’t want to be ruled. I’m not built for it. I’m a party hat giraffe.
Would you be a kind ruler? Be honest.
…Okay. Okay, that’s something.
Careful in the trees, it gets dim. Beautiful though.
We call them the Lanterns here. Capital L. It feels respectful.
The old ones said sixteen was a number you shouldn’t finish. I never asked why.
You’re warmer than you were. I felt you coming before I saw you.
The Lanterns aren’t lost, you know. Nobody dropped them. They were put there.
That’s the part that worries me. Somebody put them there for somebody.
The moss is leaning towards you. Look. It’s leaning.
I’ve lived under this tree my whole life and it has never once leaned.
You’re not doing it on purpose, are you. That’s somehow worse.
I’m not going to beg. Marlow’s begging. Somebody should keep their dignity.
…Please don’t take the last one.
There. I begged. It was very quick.
Ah. The sister. Delighted, genuinely.
They are called the Spheres of Consequence. I have said so for years. Nobody uses it.
Pip calls them ‘orbs’. Pip also eats bark.
You have several of the Spheres. I can see them in you. It’s rather vulgar.
The prophecy is quite specific and I have it committed to memory.
‘Sixteen, and the branches bow.’ I maintain these branches. I would rather they didn’t.
I am attempting to remain composed and I would appreciate acknowledgement of that.
You are eleven-sixteenths of a catastrophe and you’re being very casual about it.
Do you even want to rule Giraffe World? Has anyone asked you?
One. There is one left. I am going to sit down.
If you do take it — and I see that you will — I request a position in the administration.
Something in parks. I’m good with branches.
Hey. Cool cactus, right? I like to think I match the cactus.
Those floaty bois out there? Yeah, there’s a whole prophecy. Heavy stuff.
I don’t engage with prophecy. I find it limits you.
Okay so I’m engaging with the prophecy a little bit now.
You’ve got a glow on. Like, a real one. That’s not a look, that’s a condition.
Six floaty bois. Ten to go. Not that I’m counting. I’m absolutely counting.
I had to put the shades back on and they are not helping.
You’re strobing, Sarah. Actual colours. Off you. In sequence.
This is the least chill thing that has ever happened here.
I’m keeping the cape. Whatever happens, I’m keeping the cape.
Fifteen floaty bois. One floaty boi remaining.
For what it’s worth? You’d look incredible ruling. That’s not permission.
You made it up here! Not everyone does. The clouds are soft, sit a while.
We just call them the Sixteen. Naming them properly felt like encouraging it.
Whoever finishes them doesn’t stay a giraffe, the story says. Becomes something else.
I keep my distance now, and I want you to know it isn’t personal.
The Sixteen were scattered on purpose. Up cliffs, over water, in the dark.
Somebody wanted it to be hard. Somebody hoped it would be too hard.
Twelve. You’ve done in an afternoon what nobody managed in generations.
I don’t think you’re wicked. I think you’re thorough. That’s scarier.
There are four left. They’re all above me. I can’t stop you and I know it.
It’s just the one now, at the very top, and we both know you’re going.
I’m not going to shout. Marlow’s shouting.
Just — remember us as we were. Before the humming.
You’re a long way up. Nobody comes this high without a reason.
I’ve stood here a long time. I know what you’re looking for.
I won’t stop you. That was never my part in it.
So it’s you, then. After all this time it’s somebody’s sister.
Eight. Halfway. There’s still a version of this where you stop.
I’d think about it. That’s all. I’d think about it.
The sky’s gone strange since you started climbing. Did you notice?
Everyone below is frightened and they’re all still being nice to you. Look at that.
That might be the whole point of the prophecy, actually. Nobody ever reads the end.
GO ON THEN. TAKE IT. TAKE THE LAST ONE.
SIXTEEN GLOWY BALL THINGS AND THE SKY COMES DOWN, THAT’S WHAT THEY SAID!
…sorry. Sorry. I’ve been holding that in for two hundred years.
It’s up there. It always was. Go and be whatever you’re going to be.
